Package net.maswag.falcaun

Interface NumericSUL

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, SUL<List<Double>,IOSignalPiece<List<Double>>>
All Known Subinterfaces:
ContinuousNumericSUL
public interface NumericSUL extends SUL<List<Double>,IOSignalPiece<List<Double>>>, AutoCloseable
A SUL with numerical inputs and outputs.

In addition to the step-wise execution defined by SUL, this interface supports full-word execution through execute(Word).

Author:
Masaki Waga <masakiwaga@gmail.com>

  • Method Details

    • execute

      default IOSignal<List<Double>> execute(net.automatalib.word.Word<List<Double>> inputSignal) throws InterruptedException, ExecutionException
      Executes an input word from the initial state and returns its input/output signal.

      The default implementation calls pre(), executes each input using SUL.step(Object), and calls post() in a finally block. Thus, post() is called even if a step fails, provided pre() completed successfully.

      Implementations may override this method for backend-specific batch execution without individually calling pre(), step(), or post().

      Batch execution must not be interleaved with an active step-wise execution session.

      Parameters:
      inputSignal - the input word
      Returns:
      the corresponding input/output signal, with one output per input symbol
      Throws:
      InterruptedException
      ExecutionException

    • getExecutionCount

      int getExecutionCount()
      Returns the number of the executions of the SUL.

      What is counted as an execution is backend specific. Typically, it is the number of the sessions, i.e., the calls of pre() or execute(Word).
